formal_question:
Each square in the shape has an area of $4 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$. How long is the thick line?
Choices:
A:$16 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$18 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$20 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$21 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$23 \mathrm{~cm}$
